name: unlock-failed-json
description: The same failed unlock under `format: "json"`, recorded live 2026-10-04. Here the outer envelope carries NO `x-brd-*` header at all — the verdict rides INSIDE the body, as `status_code: 502` beside `headers.x-brd-error-code: no_peers`. A header-only check would bill it; the provider lifecycle reads the body too and settles 502 / 200, zero usage, the body passed through as the reason (design D4). Transport headers (`date`, `connection`) trimmed.
